stemMd: Two angles of a triangle are 47° and 68°. What is the exterior angle adjacent to the third angle?
explanationMd: The third interior angle is 180 − 47 − 68 = 65°. Its adjacent exterior angle is 180 − 65 = 115°. Equivalently, an exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles, 47 + 68.

distractorRationale.a: This is the third interior angle.
distractorRationale.e: This is the supplement of 68°, not of the third angle.
distractorRationale.b: An exterior angle is not automatically a straight angle.
